en: A monochrome historic postcard showing a wide dirt street bordered by wooden buildings. On the right is a large, ornate wooden school-like building with many tall windows, a small tower on the roof, and decorative gables, behind a low wooden fence. A few people, including children, walk along the street. There are telegraph poles on the left side and another wooden building in the distance. Printed captions in Finnish/Swedish appear at the top.
